description: Portrait of O'Keeffe in a profile view, sitting against an end of the portal,  dressed in a black hood, coat, and gloves, behind her are skulls hanging on the iron posts of the railing; a skull with teeth, multiple skulls with horns, adobe walls, viga beams and shadows. Next to her on the ground are bones and a large vertebrae.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Ghost Ranch Portal
